messages:
Priya Rao: Heads-up: Catalyst (customer) ready for public story next Wed. We need: final one-line quote (or 30s audio), logo permission, and webinar panel confirmed. Legal wants explicit consent language in the quote.

Mira Chen: I'll ask Catalyst for a short text quote today. Prefer verbatim. Can they give a percent for cost savings?

Tony Alvarez: I'll own the webinar logistics: 25m demo, 20m customer Q&A. Need benchmark slide (95th pct latency, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens) + one-line method note.

Azra Khan: Routing: registrants picking 'pilot' -> SDR-B, others -> nurture. I'll add hidden form field "current_inference" for segmentation. Also will create HubSpot tag `webinar-catalyst-2026`.

Sam Li: LegalBot: check the draft quote when uploaded. Reminder: remove absolutes (e.g., "no tail latency") and include consent snippet: "By providing this quote, Catalyst grants Redwood permission to publish the quote and company name."

Mira Chen: Catalyst replied: "Redwood cut our inference latency and lowered costs significantly." They declined numeric specifics.

Tony Alvarez: Fine to publish. Suggest we append: "anonymized metrics available on request" if they won't share numbers. I'll mock benchmark slide for dry run.

Priya Rao: Mira, upload the quote to /marketing/case-quotes and tick the consent box. LegalBot, run quick consent scan and flag any edits.

LegalBot: AUTO-CHECK: No absolute claims found. Consent clause missing; please append standard consent snippet. Logo use checkbox not present.

Mira Chen: Uploaded quote and added consent line. Also attached Catalyst logo (png).

Sam Li: Reviewed. Consent included. Logo permission ok. You can proceed to schedule webinar invite.

Azra Khan: Automation ready: on publish tag attendees, map hidden field to HubSpot property, route pilot leads to SDR-B.

Priya Rao: Great. Owners: Mira (quote + upload) done; Tony (slides + dry run) due Mon 3pm; Azra (routing) done; Legal (Sam) done. Closing this thread unless issues. :party_popper:
